第51章 我要告！-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》

宿舍内，刘济民听着杨波在耳边的低语声，不过他听得不认真，只能听到几个关键词，总之就是“想去”。
走廊里传来的吵闹声打断了杨波的话，宿舍门被梁满囤和李卫国一把推开，李卫国看到躺在床上的刘济民感到诧异，不过没有多想，而是拉着杨波为他评理。
“满囤真抠门，上次我帮他忙了，说要请我吃饭，晚上给我打了份大白菜，就当请客了。”李卫国不满地说道，“有这样的吗？”
“卫国同志，工人老大哥，你怎么这么计较？满囤不是没钱吗？要是满囤有钱，直接燕京饭店包圆喽！”杨波笑着说道。
梁满囤点头道：“等我以后有钱再请你！”
“得了吧，我还不知道你，抠门抠到家了，夏天说要请我吃小豆冰棍，买了后自己先啃了半根。没事儿，谁让我是工人老大哥呢，得发扬风格！”
刘济民附和着笑了一下，就继续思考去了。杨波见人都回来了，也没有再说话，躺在床上也不知道在想什么。
第一天一早，刘济民先到行政楼办了休学和学籍保留的手续。出来的时候，遇见了新生辅导员王炳文，曾经王炳文觉得刘济民是刺头，现在他觉得刘济民是嫉恶如仇，个性十足。
每次在学校里遇见，王老师从表情到肢体，都在表达着热情。
“济民同学，你这是？”王炳文笑眯眯地问道。
“王老师，我要回部队了！”
“你也要回了？”王炳文诧异地问道，“到底怎么回事，最近不少军队学员收到了归队通知。”
“我也不知道，命令来了咱就走呗，回见了您！”刘济民转身就走出了行政楼。
王炳文追上去说道：“有时间记得回来看看，这里就是你的家！”
王炳文觉得既然部队调走了，估计就不会回来了。现在工农兵大学生政策调整，虽说保留学籍，但保不准什么时候就没了。
办完手续之后，刘济民骑着自行车准备回菊儿胡同一趟。路过南锣鼓巷，拐进了帽儿胡同，刘济民不由自主地在可园停了下来。
可园是冯巩家的祖宅，民国大总统冯国璋购买的，只不过买了一年就去世了，冯家搬迁到了天津。
刘济民望着这个四合院垂涎三尺，暗道要能成为老刘家的就好了。可惜，目前这里是公产。
还没回到大杂院，刘济民就看到王爱梅同志戴着红袖箍，挨家挨户宣传防火呢。

In the dormitory, Liu Jimin listened to Yang Bo whispering in his ear, but he didn't listen carefully and could only hear a few key words, in short, "want to go".
The noise coming from the corridor interrupted Yang Bo's words. The dormitory door was pushed open by Liang Mandun and Li Weiguo. Li Weiguo was surprised to see Liu Jimin lying on the bed, but he didn't think much about it and pulled Yang Bo to judge him.
"Mancun is really stingy. I helped him last time and said he wanted to treat me to dinner. He served me a piece of Chinese cabbage and treated it as a treat." Li Weiguo said dissatisfiedly, "Is there such a thing?"
"Comrade Weiguo, big brother worker, why are you so concerned? Aren't Manchan not rich? If Manchan had money, he would just arrange it at Yanjing Hotel!" Yang Bo said with a smile.
Liang Manyun nodded and said, "I will treat you later when I have money!"
"Come on, I didn't know you were stingy. Xia Tian said he wanted to treat me to some adzuki bean popsicles. After buying them, I ate half of one myself. It's okay. Who told me to be the big brother of the workers? I have to carry forward my style!"
Liu Jimin laughed in agreement and continued to think. When Yang Bo saw that everyone was back, he didn't speak anymore. He didn't know what he was thinking while lying on the bed.
On the morning of the first day, Liu Jimin went to the administration building to go through the formalities of suspending school and retaining his student status. When he came out, he met Wang Bingwen, the freshman counselor. Wang Bingwen once thought Liu Jimin was a thorn in the side, but now he thinks Liu Jimin is jealous of evil and full of personality.
Every time I meet him in school, Teacher Wang expresses his enthusiasm from his expression to his body.
"Classmate Jimin, what are you doing?" Wang Bingwen asked with a smile.
"Teacher Wang, I'm going back to the army!"
"Are you going back too?" Wang Bingwen asked in surprise, "What's going on? Recently, many military cadets have received notices to return to the army."
"I don't know either. Let's leave as soon as the order comes. I'll see you later!" Liu Jimin turned around and walked out of the administration building.
Wang Bingwen caught up and said, "Remember to come back and take a look when you have time. This is your home!"
Wang Bingwen felt that since the troops were transferred, they probably would not come back. Now that the policies for workers, peasants and soldiers college students have been adjusted, although their student status is retained, there is no guarantee when it will be lost.
After completing the formalities, Liu Jimin rode his bicycle and prepared to go back to Ju'er Hutong. Passing by Nanluogu Lane and turning into Maoer Hutong, Liu Jimin involuntarily stopped at Keyuan.
Keyuan is the ancestral home of the Feng Gong family. It was purchased by Feng Guozhang, the president of the Republic of China. He passed away just one year after buying it, and the Feng family moved to Tianjin.
Liu Jimin looked at this courtyard and salivated, secretly thinking that he would be a member of the old Liu family. Unfortunately, this is currently public property.
Before returning to the courtyard, Liu Jimin saw Comrade Wang Aimei wearing red sleeve hoops and going door to door to promote fire prevention.
